description:
LifeClock turns your remaining time into something you can actually feel. Enter your birthday and life expectancy, then watch your life unfold as a live counter, a progress view, and a visual life grid.

Switch between years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, or seconds. Personalize the experience with bold themes, typography presets, and widgets that keep your perspective close at hand.

LifeClock Lifetime unlocks the full experience with one purchase. No subscriptions, no recurring fees.
promotionalText: See your life as time, not just dates.
